setup: git init -q -b main . && mkdir -p scripts spec/stories
{ printf "# cambia el estado de la historia\nopen('salida.csv', 'w').write('x')\n"; yes '# xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' | head -n 6000; } > scripts/barrido.py
